subject: BlueWater kickoff: aligning stakeholder windows and meeting room details
messages:
From: Jordan Park <jordan.park@bluewateranalytics.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.n@bluewateranalytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial orchestration: Kickstart timing for BlueWater integration

Hi Olga —

Thanks for taking this on. We’d like to get the official kickoff on the calendar so our product, infra and security folks can align with your team. Our goals for the first session are to:
- Share mutual action plan and timelines
- Confirm network and access pre-reqs (VPC, IPs, KMS)
- Assign owners and review initial success metrics

Availability windows from our side (Pacific):
- Tue Jul 27: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:30
- Wed Jul 28: 09:30–11:00
- Fri Jul 30: 13:00–15:00

Attendees we plan to have: Jordan Park (Product lead), Priya Natarajan (DevOps), Miguel Ramos (Security, will join if network topics go deep). Could you share whom on Redwood should attend and who will lead the walkthrough? Also curious if you prefer a single 90-minute session or two focused 45-minute blocks (intro + technical deep dive).

We can share our short prework doc once we lock a slot.

Thanks,
Jordan Park
Product Manager | BlueWater Analytics
--
BlueWater Analytics
jordan.park@bluewateranalytics.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Park <jordan.park@bluewateranalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial orchestration: Kickstart timing for BlueWater integration

Hi Jordan —

Great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the windows — those give us good flexibility. We recommend one 90-minute kickoff that combines the mutual action plan + a short technical checklist (15–20m) followed by a technical deep dive (60m). That format helps reduce context switching for your security and infra folks.

Proposed slots (I’ll protect calendar placeholders until you confirm):
- Tue Jul 27, 15:00–16:30 PT
- Wed Jul 28, 09:30–11:00 PT

Tentative Redwood attendees and roles:
- Olga Petrov — Customer Success Lead (kickoff host / mutual action plan)
- Marissa Cole — Solutions Engineer (technical deep dive & integration path)
- Dev Patel — Onboarding Engineer (access setup, runbooks)
- Karthik Iyer — Security & Compliance (availability dependent; will join for network/KMS portion)

Could you confirm which slot works and whether Miguel will join for the network segment? I’ll send a calendar invite and attach an agenda + prework checklist.

Olga Petrov
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-07-20T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial orchestration: Kickstart timing for BlueWater integration

Olga / Dev —

Quick internal note: I’ll own the technical walkthrough and will prepare two short sections: 1) architecture & runtime mapping (20m) and 2) access/config checklist + handoff (40m). Dev, can you prepare the onboarding runbook snippet (IP allowlist, sample terraform snippet, and KMS integration notes)? I attached the prework checklist I usually send — small edits for BlueWater.

Also, Karthik: please confirm whether you can join the first 25 minutes for the KMS/network Q&A. If not, I’ll mark the agenda for optional security deep dive in week 2.

Attachments: prework-checklist.xlsx (internal copy)

Marissa Cole

Subject: Confirmed: Tue Jul 27, 15:00–16:30 PT — BlueWater kickoff (agenda + links)

Jordan / Priya —

Thanks — Tue Jul 27, 15:00–16:30 PT works for our team. Calendar invite attached below (I reserved a 90-minute slot). Meeting details:

- When: Tue Jul 27, 2026 • 15:00–16:30 PT
- Where: Google Meet -> https://meet.google.com/xyz-kwm-ptq
- Dial-in: +1 650-555-0123 PIN: 123 456 789#

Attached: BW-kickoff-agenda-v2.pdf (contains time-boxed agenda and owners), prework-checklist.xlsx (copy we referenced).

Agenda (high-level):
1) Introductions & success metrics (10m) — Olga
2) Mutual action plan and timeline (10m) — Olga
3) Architecture mapping / runtime choices (20m) — Marissa
4) Network, access, and KMS checklist (25m) — Dev & Karthik
5) Next steps & owner assignments (15m)

Action items before the call:
- BlueWater: share any existing network diagrams and confirm whether Miguel will join the network section (reply to all).
- Redwood: we’ll provide the runbook snippets and a minimal IAM policy example in the shared Drive folder prior to the call.

If anything changes, flag here and I’ll update the invite. Looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Olga Petrov
